description: 池上斷層地質敏感區介紹多媒體 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 池上斷層為逆移兼具左移分量之斷層，1951年臺東地震與2003 年成功地震皆造成斷層沿線部分地區地表破裂現象。 由池上斷層的古地震研究結果顯示，過去有多次地震事件造成沉積層錯移，依目前的調查資料而顯示，大多數的地表破裂都沿者同一位置或相近位置的既有斷層面再度活動，形成有極明顯的地形特徵。 池上斷層活動斷層地質敏感區位於臺灣東部，北起花蓮縣... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
